data.gender_notes: Luci is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'lucere', meaning 'to shine', 'to be light'. In early Christianity, the name Luci was given to those who were baptized and brought light into the world. This name also holds biblical significance as the name of several saints and martyrs. The name Luci carries the meaning “Light, Luminous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Luci usually hope their child will grow to embody light, luminous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing light and hope to others.
data.etymology: Luci belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Luminous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luci total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Luci has been popular in various European countries such as Italy, Portugal, and Poland. It has a rich cultural heritage and is associated with the ancient Roman goddess of light, Lucina. In many parts of Europe, the name Luci is used as a feminine form of the name Lucian, which means 'bringer of light'.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Luci holds deep spiritual significance as it symbolizes the light of God in the life of a believer. It represents the inner light that guides us through the darkest times and the outer light that shines out for others to see our faith and goodness. The name Luci is also associated with the virtues of truth, honesty, and integrity, as these qualities help us to shine brightly in the world. Overall, the name Luci is a powerful reminder of the light of God and the importance of sharing that light with others.
